Oh trust me, I know all about the inspirational well running dry just after the best drink in your life….. I think I'll cut the metaphor off before it runs away.

Honestly that's kinda what I was thinking; if not following the guy himself as he stumbles into That Which Should Not Be, some more looks into that wonderful little twilit world just between the comfortable and the Wrong..
